Reading 3 then widens to `pm:dispatched` ∪ `pm:queue` cards whose branch moved since the last shift-end brief (one `git ls-remote` per card, the same probe the seat already uses for queue refs), counting a remote push as evidence of a live session even before the comment lands. Both fit one line in SKILL.md §入口与角色 (line-neutral at 811/811); the claim ↔ PR required check (#15845, devx) is the CI-side twin of the same fact.

p3: one collision, caught by hand within the shift. Dispatch after the two SKILL.md flights at the terminal land (PR #15946, and #16003's line, which touches the neighbouring rows).
